owns: Book Evaluator capability and qualification lane

parallel_safe_support.purpose: Preserve and reconcile completed Night Shift research/implementation, then dedupe and implement only genuinely missing evaluator-robustness support that can be completed without touching the six blind ground-truth cases.
parallel_safe_support.completion_rule: Inspect existing implementation first. Implement and qualify only uncovered support gaps on independent fixtures; otherwise preserve a no-code evidence-backed dedupe finding.
parallel_safe_support.stop_condition: P4 Prose completion/evidence census is durably checkpointed and at least the highest-priority uncovered independent-fixture robustness gap is implemented and tested, or evidence proves it already exists; produce a tomorrow-ready successor matrix.
must_not_do: do not read or score the six blind LGT cases as part of this support objective
do not tune against author labels or sealed blind predictions
do not repeat completed Night Shift work merely because an old delegation became stale
do not generate candidate prose or mutate manuscripts
do not alter Book canonical state or grant revision/publication authority

core_relationship: PROSE consumes shared System Master Core services through governed interfaces but Core does not own Prose literary/evaluator product logic.
second_shift_rule: Prose unattended delegation is owned by governance/second-shift/PROSE-DELEGATIONS.json and must be revalidated against the live literary-prose-engine-001 head. Author-only evidence dependencies cannot be delegated. Independent-fixture evaluator robustness and Prose census/reconciliation may be delegated when explicitly bound to the live head and isolated from blind-case ground truth.
historical_alias_rule: PROSE PROJECT, LITERARY PROSE SYSTEM, LITERARY PROSE ENGINE, BOOK-WRITING-SYSTEM-LITERARY-LANE and related names remain historical/implementation aliases only.

control_revalidation.reason: Reconcile AUTHORITY_DELTA after exact author-adjudication evidence advanced the Prose critical path beyond State-014, then preserve a dependency-valid parallel support lane for nonblind evaluator robustness and completion/evidence reconciliation.

qualification_rule: This binding changes control/current-selection and parallel-support metadata only. It does not transfer, broaden or invalidate prior exact-SHA qualification, private-data, human, author, revision, publication or production authority.
